annotationRationale: The solution counts factors of two in a factorial, counts divisors through exponent choices, and converts the odd-divisor proportion into an equally likely probability.
sourceMethod: Follows the official grouping by odd divisors of k after writing 21! as 2^18 times an odd integer; omits the optional full prime factorization.

review.mathCheck: The exponent of 2 is \(10+5+2+1=18\). Every odd divisor of the odd part generates exactly 19 divisors through exponents 0–18, with only exponent 0 producing an odd divisor. Hence the probability is \(1/19\), choice B; the stated divisor total is consistent with \(60800=19\cdot3200\).
review.sourceMethodCheck: The candidate originally rephrases official solution 20 on page 7, retaining prime-power counting and grouping by odd part. Omitting the optional complete factorization loses no necessary reasoning.
